title: Lab request efficiency: basic screens must not need heavy cloud work
description: Ryan 2026-10-23: opening the Anthus workspace failed with 'API call failed' / 'service unavailable'. Cause: the BFF hit the account Lambda concurrency limit of 10 (Throttles 12). Each request costs 6-20 s (mean 11.7 s): three sequential Prospectus calls (~4.8 s: identities/me twice + authorize) plus ~7 uncached whole-catalog S3 reads and validations per run-details query (~6 s). The served UI re-sends the run-details query every second with setInterval and never waits, so ~16 requests are in flight. Quota increase to 1000 requested (2b1494c13ba047d09585be7728017d48YPmQxmKY) as a safety margin only. Goal: a workspace load is a handful of requests, each well under a second, so 10 concurrent is ample. Related: C4 catalog write amplification.
